PawnIO 2.2.0 official installer
Copyright (C) namazso. https://pawnio.eu/

OpenBlade distributes the original, unmodified official PawnIO installer.
The installer explicitly permits unmodified redistribution. OpenBlade does not
modify, re-sign, extract or replace the vendor's driver installer.

Source: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO
Release: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/tag/2.2.0
Installer: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/download/2.2.0/PawnIO_setup.exe
SHA-256: 1f519a22e47187f70a1379a48ca604981c4fcf694f4e65b734aaa74a9fba3032
Redistribution permission:
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/wiki/Using-PawnIO-Modules
https://github.com/a1ive/nwinfo/issues/86

PawnIO is a shared system driver. OpenBlade preserves an existing trusted
installation and never removes PawnIO when OpenBlade is uninstalled.
Temperature sensing remains unavailable until the actual driver is trusted,
started and successfully completes the required read-only API/module handshake.
